Data integrity. Emissions & reduction are computed as Output × GEI directly from the 745 gazette facility rows (Phase 1–3). "Company", "District" and "Locality" are parsed from the facility name text (not an independent ownership/administrative registry) — use as a navigation aid, not a legal record. District/locality names are normalized to current official names (e.g. Gulbarga→Kalaburagi, Bellary→Ballari, Belgaum→Belagavi, per 2014 Karnataka govt. renaming) — old names still match in search. "Parent group" rolls up 135 of 745 facilities into 13 well-known conglomerates (Tata, JSW, Vedanta, Adani, Aditya Birla, SAIL, Reliance, Dalmia Bharat, JK, Shree, Jindal*, NALCO, ITC) via a supplied name-mapping table, checked against our data for false-positive matches; the remaining 610 facilities show under their own registered name since no group mapping exists for them. *Jindal Group merges two separately-run listed companies — see the Group Intelligence panel for detail.

GEI & Environmental Compensation Calculator Rule 5 & Rule 6, GHG Emission Intensity Target Rules, 2025

Environmental compensation = shortfall CCCs × 2 × average CCC trading price for the compliance year (Rule 6(1)). The Bureau of Energy Efficiency sets the actual average price — India's carbon market isn't trading yet, so the price above is a placeholder you control, not an official figure.
